request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a spooky ghost galleon: the pale hull becomes near-black charcoal wood, colour #2a2a30, with pale ivory bone ribs along its side and a pale ivory skull figurehead; the grey stone tower becomes black wood; the red sails become tattered dark charcoal grey cloth, colour #5a5660, with torn zigzag edges; the pennants become black rags; two small lanterns glow bright violet. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
